# What CI runs. scripts/plan-ci.ts turns this into the typescript workflow's
# matrices; the documentation gates and the argv budget test read it too.
#
# One entry per line: a kind, then a value. Releases run oldest first.
#
#   supported    a released tmux in the support table. A push or pull request
#                runs the first and the last.
#   preview      a branch that becomes a release. It has no tag yet, so it
#                runs with the whole table and is not in the support claim.
#   development  unreleased tmux. It runs with the whole table and may fail.
#   bun          a Bun version the gates job runs
#   lane-bun     the Bun version the tmux lanes run, one of the above
